$comment: LQ-WP04 chain-touch map (planset 2026-11-07-v060, lanes/LQ_NON_REGRESSION_GUARD.md sections 3.1, 4.1, 4.3). Schema v1 is frozen.

Read by scripts/ci/lq/chain-touch.mjs (the lq / chain-touch check). The check reads this file from the PR's BASE commit, so a PR cannot widen or narrow its own guard; change it in its own PR (CODEOWNERS: the owner).

Class A and B are citrate-chain paths (rules, node integrity). LQ never edits chain; LQ-WP06 reads class A for the source fingerprint and component-pins NODE_CONSENSUS_PATHS. Class C is what citrate-core ships that is chain-adjacent; the check fails a PR that changes a class C path unless it is a chain-touch PR (label, evidence, agreement run, and for a rules delta the consensus review).
Path syntax: a trailing '/' matches everything under it; '**/' matches zero or more directories; '*' matches within one path segment; anything else is an exact path.

classes.C.scoped: files where only part of the file is class C. kind 'lines' compares the lines matching 'match' (case-insensitive) at base and head; kind 'json-entry' compares one element of a JSON array; kind 'lock-closure' compares the Cargo.lock packages reachable from the roots (and from every package whose source matches source_match). An unreadable or unparsable scoped file counts as changed (fail closed).

classes.C.rules_paths: core files that set a consensus input the node reads (genesis, activation heights, the network cut). A change to one is a rules delta: it needs the consensus-review label and an approval from release/consensus-reviewers.json, like a changed rules fingerprint.
chain_touch_branches: the only branch prefixes a chain-touch PR may come from (policy 2). lane_branch_pattern: product-lane branches, refused outright on any class C change (policy 1).

A.why: consensus rules: block validity, state transition, fork choice, genesis

B.why: node integrity: code the node binary links that is not rules

C.why: chain-adjacent in Core: what chain bytes, crates, genesis, book or node launch Core ships

scoped.why: the chain git dependencies (and any [patch] that redirects them)
a lockfile move of any crate the chain crates pull (k256, sha3, rlp, bip32, ...) changes tx-signing code
the bundled node's source rev, per-target revs and pinned bytes
